difficulty_reason: Characterize strongly cartesian morphisms (f, g) : X/U -> Y/V of Spacesstack as exactly those with f : X -> U x_{g, V} Y an isomorphism: the projection p : U x_{g, V} Y -> Y gives a morphism (p, g) : U x_{g, V} Y/U -> Y/V; claim (p, g) is strongly cartesian by the coproduct computation Mor_{Spacesstack}(Z/W, U x_{g, V} Y/U) = coprod_h Mor_{Spaces/W}(Z, W x_{h, U} U x_{g, V} Y) = coprod_h Mor(Z, W x_{g o h, V} Y) = Mor_{Spacesstack}(Z/W, Y/V) x_{Mor_S(W, V)} Mor_S(W, U) using equation-morphisms-spaces twice - the cartesian condition of categories-definition-cartesian-over-C; the 'if' direction follows from composition stability (categories-lemma-composition-cartesian); the 'only if' direction from uniqueness up to isomorphism of the cartesian lift of g.
